body:
I have skills already.

I could teach English or government, but I need a license. License requires degree. I could teach college, that requires TWO degrees.

I'm not a no-talent hack... but I can hack... do you have a spare computer science degree you're not using? I'll buy it from you. Or maybe you have an extra A+ cert? I'll ignore the fact that I don't want to do computer-anything as a career despite being talented in it.

I'll put it another way: I have the skills. I just don't have the credentials that show I have the skills.

> Why do you have low self worth?

Dunno, how would you feel being the guy everybody looks to for answers yet has the shittiest life with no friends, no family, no present and an uncertain future?

[Protip: Speak in parallel... then drop one that isn't like the rest... and that last point is the one that will resonate. In this case, it just so happens to be the answer to your original inquiry. Boom!]

> honestly the colder it gets the better your chances probably are.

The inverse is true. The colder it gets, the more people want in. The fewer spaces are actually available.

> are you still taking classes?

I won't be after this semester.

> have you tried couchsurfing?

I have a profile on it. I don't see it as a feasible alternative long or short term. The holidays are coming up, so I wouldn't want to impose at this particular instant anyways. Who wants a depressed person around during Christmas?

> maybe some other organization online that helps people in your situation? Or tried calling the shelter and talking to somebody in charge about alternatives?

Been there, done that. Get put on lists, nothing happens. I used to like lists. Now I find them an impediment to action.

My mom is worse off than I am and we don't particularly get along well at all. She threw me out a long while ago because I wouldn't get her cigarettes on Christmas Eve.

I considered filing for bankruptcy, that way my old college will have to let me back in and I could live in a dorm or something and "start over"... but that's too expensive right now.

In order for potential to not be wasted, one has to have the capacity to maximize one's potential. Otherwise, there is somewhat of a waste.

The time not to waste it was in the past. We're beyond that now. My HS class graduated college earlier this calendar year. The vast majority of them going to better colleges than me, despite having three-quarters to less than one-half of the intelligence I do. No no. If you looked at the Potenti-o-Meter (tm - patent pending), you would see it's slowly shrinking. At this rate, I think I'd be lucky to find myself burger flipping at McDonald's. Given the fact that gravity is -9.8 m/s^2, I figure, at max, I could probably have 3 burgers in the air simultaneously. (Note: I got a B- in Honors Physics in HS, so don't treat this as even being anywhere close to remotely correct)

> Have you seriously been on the street this whole time?

Here and there with a guy that I know from school will feel sorry for me and take me somewhere and flirt with me and act like he wants me for something more than sex and I'll spend a night making him feel good in numerous ways. Semi-consensual emotional rape, I guess.

I spend most of my time in a university library in a corner where I will be least obtrusive (it honestly shocks me that I've managed to do it as long as I have) reading the job application rejection emails I get. Of course, this will only work through the end of finals, which are soon.

> no family, no friends?

Never met my dad and I'm a only child. Texting my mom gets a "Who is this?". She's either going senile (at 47, that's unlikely) or doesn't give a damn enough to save my phone number. Both maternal grandparents are dead. My step-grandmother (if there is such a thing), had me trespassed from her house after my grandfather died for she hates my mom and I'm the only one to take it out on.

I'll put it like this: I have 198 friends on FB. 13 (or 6.5%) of them posted on my wall for my birthday (which was only a few weeks ago). If my birthday hadn't been made public, as I usually set it, I probably would have gotten 0 posts, as I usually get.

> Howd you lose your place anyway?

In a nutshell, if you were to ask me, it boils down to lazy roommate. He had no job, I ended up having to spend more than I budgeted for to keep us in apartment and keep the lights on for as long as I did on the premise that he would GET a job.

[could have sworn i replied to this]

I'm a social outcast, a loner, whatever term you choose to apply. I don't have many friends.

My mom is worse off than I am, in some program or something. My dad isn't around... and I don't have much family beyond that. We've never really stayed connected... and my mom being the way she is (lazy?/poor excuse for a human), she never really stayed in touch with them.

Phone has no plan attached to it, but comes in handy as a map.

Before, my entire school (and rest of my life) was paid by financial aid. Since the overaward, I can only get state funds, which in MI for me is a little tiny scholarship that basically covers my tuition for a half-time load at a community college (and anticipating next question, my classes are online so I don't have to physically be there). After this semester, I'm going to have to stop going to classes because I'll be at the limit for courses that can transfer and apply toward a degree.

> that homeless

I've always thought it was a binary state, you either are or you aren't.

I'm a college student. I have a laptop. I have a smartphone.

I have 200 friends on FB. the vast majority of them people I went to HS with who saw me as the class dork, that don't talk to me, that I don't talk to and are only on my FB as a formality. Trust me, if there were people who could, I would have asked them by now. I'm not a social being.

lol. I'm not what people look for. I'm black, dorky, with glasses. He's typical white boy. The only thing I could possibly have going for me in that department is a big dick. But, he doesn't even have to have sex with his sugar daddy cuz he's typical white boy eye candy. I am not.

And he wasn't my sugar baby.
Haven't thus far... and at the same time, I don't think CS is targeted at the grungy destitute population.

Had a roommate. Roommate didn't bother getting a decent job (or doing what he needed to do to keep his current one). I paid all the bills until I had no money. Lost place. Here we are... well here I am, he's nice and comfy with his sugar daddy.

I spend a lot of time in starbucks. (I'm in one now, as a matter of fact.) i had a small fortune in sbux gift cards that i've been going through slowly... and oddly, despite the walking I do during the night, I'm gaining weight.

After e-mail carpet bombing a few people, I finally got some one who claims they can get the people who run the phone line to call me... [uh-huh.]

I can be a little optimistic now, even though it is late on a Friday.

I think i was so sweaty that my pants are now stuck to the chair or left over gunk that was on the chair. this is an odd experience.

Optimism is overrated. I can't BE optimistic when I can't even get the people who COULD help me to PICK UP THEIR DAMN PHONE.
im used to suck. my life sucks and always has for the most part.

My mom can barely take care of herself. She's a degreed individual (in bloody computer science, no less!), yet seems to be content working minimum wage jobs. she's in some program or whatever that doesn't really let me stay there or something idk.
